identity: A page combines two or three independent task widgets in cards, each with its own control to set.

scenarios.name: booking
scenarios.screen: Two or three cards show blank text fields, a choice control, and a date or time control. A dropdown or autocomplete list is closed, and a calendar popup is closed; the requested entries and selections are not yet set.
never: A dropdown or autocomplete list already open.

arrangements.text: The text card sits above the choice card, with the date card below it.
The text card sits to the left of the choice card, and the date card sits to their right.
The text and choice cards share the top row, with the date card centered beneath them.

scenarios.name: filters
scenarios.screen: Two or three cards show a slider, a choice control, and a blank search field. The slider starts away from its requested setting; visible checkbox or radio choices are unselected, while a dropdown or listbox shows no requested choice.
never: A date picker or color picker.
Checkboxes already checked for the requested answer.
A search field already filled with the requested text.

arrangements.text: The slider card sits above the choice card, with the search field card below it.
The slider card sits to the left of the choice card, and the search field card sits to their right.
The slider and choice cards share the top row, with the search field card beneath them.

scenarios.name: profile
scenarios.screen: Two or three cards show blank profile text fields, a choice control, and a color control. A dropdown or autocomplete list is closed, and the selected color has not been set to the requested color.
never: A dropdown or autocomplete list already open.
The selected color already matching the requested color.

arrangements.text: The text card sits above the choice card, with the color card below it.
The text card sits to the left of the choice card, and the color card sits to their right.
The text and choice cards share the top row, with the color card beneath them.

scenarios.name: appearance
scenarios.screen: Two or three cards show a color control, a slider, and a choice control. The selected color and slider setting are away from their requested values, and a dropdown list is closed when the choice uses a dropdown.
never: Slider handles already at the requested setting.

arrangements.text: The color card sits above the slider card, with the choice card below it.
The color card sits to the left of the slider card, and the choice card sits to their right.
The color and slider cards share the top row, with the choice card beneath them.

scenarios.name: planner
scenarios.screen: Three cards show a date or date range control, a slider, and a choice control. The requested date, slider setting, and choice are not yet set; calendar and dropdown popups are closed.
never: A color picker or text entry form.

arrangements.text: The date card sits above the slider card, with the choice card below it.
The date card sits to the left of the slider card, and the choice card sits to their right.
The date and slider cards share the top row, with the choice card beneath them.

scenarios.name: event
scenarios.screen: Three cards show blank text fields, a date or time control, and a color control. The requested entries, date or time, and color are not yet set, and a calendar popup is closed when the date uses one.
never: Text fields already filled with the requested details.

arrangements.text: The text card sits above the date card, with the color card below it.
The text card sits to the left of the date card, and the color card sits to their right.
The text and date cards share the top row, with the color card beneath them.
